**Package:** `dev.joid.tool.msdf.atlas` · **Module:** `tool-msdf` · **Source:** [GlyphEntry.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/tool/msdf/src/main/java/dev/joid/tool/msdf/atlas/GlyphEntry.java)
